home-hero-title: Premium Greek Products for Wholesale & Export
home-hero-subtitle: Single-origin honey from Kos Island, crafted in small batches and supplied in both bulk and retail packaging.
home-hero-pillar-1: Wholesale focus - Bulk quantities from 20kg up to full pallet orders.
home-hero-pillar-2: Consistent quality - Lab-tested batches and traceable production.
home-hero-pillar-3: Export-ready - EU standards, professional packaging and logistics support.
home-who-body: AETHERA is a family-run honey producer based in Kos Island, Greece. We focus on premium, single-origin honey sourced from the unique flora of the Aegean. Our goal is to build long-term partnerships with importers, distributors and retailers who value consistent quality and transparent production.
home-product1-desc: Premium glass jars (250g / 450g / 950g) for gourmet retail and boutique shelves.
home-product2-desc: Cold-pressed EVOO for premium retail and HORECA programs; bulk tins and IBC on request.
home-cta-text: Share destination, volumes, and packaging needs. We respond within 24 hours.
products-lead: Two core products for professional buyers. At a glance: single-origin thyme honey from Kos Island and cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil. Both available in retail and bulk, export-ready with full documentation.
products-fact1-text: Our branded jars and bottles, ready for shelves and gifting.
products-fact2-text: Honey: 20kg / 50kg / 300kg. EVOO: tins, drums, IBC on request.
products-fact3-text: Lab analyses, batch traceability, EU-compliant labels.
products-fact4-text: Palletized loads, QC photos on request, responsive support.
products-honey-desc: Single-origin thyme honey from Kefalos, Kos. Raw, unblended, lab-tested. Clear origin and steady supply for professional buyers.
products-honey-retail-3: Cases of 6 or 12; EN labels, GR/DE optional
products-honey-bulk-3: Traceable lots; COA (diastase, HMF, moisture, conductivity)
products-honey-logistics-3: Lead time: 1-3 weeks depending on labels and stock
products-olive-desc: Cold-pressed EVOO with balanced bitterness and a peppery finish. Retail and bulk options for premium programs and HORECA.
products-olive-retail-3: Cases of 6 or 12; gift box options
products-olive-logistics-3: Lead time: 1-3 weeks depending on packaging
products-cta-text: Tell us your volumes, destination, and packaging needs. We respond within 24 hours.
about-lead: Export-focused honey producer from Kos Island, Greece. We supply wholesalers, distributors and hospitality groups with retail-ready jars and bulk drums backed by lab-tested quality.
about-snapshot-3: Focus: Single-origin thyme, pine & wildflower honey
about-snapshot-4: Exports: Retail jars & bulk for EU/international partners
about-production-4: Lead times: 1-3 weeks depending on labels and stock
about-quality-1: Batch traceability by harvest and apiary location
about-quality-2: Lab analyses: diastase, HMF, moisture, conductivity
about-quality-4: EU food safety and export documentation provided
about-steps-1: Raw intake: visual inspection, moisture check, lot coding
about-steps-2: Lab verification: diastase, HMF, conductivity per batch
about-steps-3: Packing: filtered for particulates, unheated to preserve enzymes
about-sustain-1: Apiaries placed among thyme and pine flora in Kos
about-sustain-2: Minimal transport; no antibiotics; careful swarm management
about-sustain-3: Respectful harvesting to maintain colony health
about-docs-1: COA and lab PDF available per shipment
about-docs-2: Traceable batch IDs and harvest season on labels
